name: rigol_mho98
description: Rigol MHO98 4-channel 1 GHz 4 GSa/s 12-bit oscilloscope with 500 Mpts memory, 16-channel logic analyzer and dual 100 MHz arbitrary waveform generator. Firmware v1.05.02.
author: Community

eez-studio.moreDescription:
Comprehensive MHO98 support module.

Connection: Ethernet (LXI) port 5555 or USBTMC. Enter the instrument IP manually when adding to EEZ Studio. Default lab address: 192.168.1.51

TOOLBAR:
- Run / Stop / Single / Auto / Force - acquisition control
- Capture - all displayed channels to charts
- Live Meas - continuous Vpp/Vrms/Freq/Period/Vmax/Vmin (click Stop to end)
- Vertical - per-channel: On/Off, coupling, impedance, probe, scale, offset, unit, BW limit, invert, fine
- Trigger - source, slope, level, sweep, coupling, holdoff, noise reject
- Horizontal - timebase scale/position/mode, acquisition type, averages, memory depth, expand reference; reports live sample rate
- Measure - all items grouped Vertical (voltage) / Horizontal (time) / Other (count, delay, phase); optional on-screen statistic
- AWG Setup - configure a generator channel

SCRIPTS LIST: per-channel quick toggles, AWG output toggles, screenshot, clear errors, diagnostic, reset.

Capture uses RIGOL_BYTE format with the standard preamble conversion V = (raw - YORigin - YREFerence) x YINCrement.
